title: Northstar Digital Forensics capstone
context: Run a complete simulated agency engagement for a secure case-intake and evidence-metadata portal using synthetic data and explicit non-production claims.

stories.title: Turn the RFP into an approved product plan
stories.outcome: Stakeholders agree on users, release scope, risks, estimate, and acceptance before implementation.
stories.context: Review the Northstar brief and write discovery questions before reading the supplied discovery notes as client answers.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD defines personas, journeys, goals, success, scope, non-goals, assumptions, risks, and acceptance
Estimate shows discovery/design/build/QA/launch/handoff and uncertainty
The phrase chain of custody is corrected to educational timestamped activity history
Client approval record captures the accepted scope
stories.dataContract: PRD, discovery, estimate, and approval templates.

expectations.security: Synthetic data and non-production boundary explicit.
expectations.privacy: No real evidence or client identity.
expectations.analytics: Define intake completion and review readiness only.

stories.title: Approve schema, authorization, and threat model
stories.outcome: The technical design proves tenant and role boundaries before feature work.
stories.context: Model profiles, organizations, memberships, cases, evidence_items, and audit_events with migrations, seeds, RLS, private storage, and an access matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: ER diagram and data dictionary define keys, relationships, lifecycle, and safe event context
Access matrix covers anonymous, client A, client B, investigator, admin, revoked membership, URL, database, and storage
Threat model addresses IDOR, role tampering, broad RLS, unsafe uploads, sensitive logs, notifications, and credentials
Architecture decisions state tradeoffs and non-claims
stories.dataContract: Minimum domain model from curriculum milestone 11.
definitionOfDone: Architecture review passes before UI build

stories.title: Deliver client case intake
stories.outcome: An authorized client can create a case, save structured intake, add safe evidence metadata/sample files, and submit for review.
stories.context: Use the approved status transitions and private storage. File contents are harmless fixtures only.
acceptanceCriteria: Client sees only their organization's cases
Required metadata and transition to ready_for_review are server validated
Sample uploads enforce allowed type/size, private path, and authorized signed access
Important actions create safe timestamped audit events
Loading, validation, upload failure, retry, and success states are accessible
stories.dataContract: Approved cases/evidence_items/audit_events schema and status transition table.

expectations.security: Identity/organization from trusted session; private storage.
expectations.accessibility: Error summary, progress, status text, mobile behavior.

definitionOfDone: Client workflow browser and authorization tests pass

stories.title: Deliver investigator queue and review
stories.outcome: An investigator can identify assigned work, review authorized cases, request information, and change valid statuses.
stories.context: Queue filters must not become a global data leak. Client-visible updates and internal operational context are distinct.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue contains only authorized assigned/role-visible cases
Search and filters preserve tenant/role boundaries
Only allowed role/status transitions succeed
Client-visible notification contains reference/action only
Every state change creates an attributable safe audit event

expectations.security: Filter is not authorization; enforce underlying query/policy.

definitionOfDone: Investigator workflow and transition tests pass

stories.title: Deliver membership and assignment administration
stories.outcome: An administrator can manage training memberships and assignments without trusting client-provided roles.
stories.context: Privilege changes and disabled memberships must have explicit effects and audit events.
acceptanceCriteria: Only administrator can change role/membership and investigator assignment
Revoked member loses new access immediately according to documented session behavior
Existing cases remain owned by organization and are not orphaned
Privilege and assignment changes create safe audit events

expectations.security: Role cannot be selected in an untrusted profile update.
expectations.privacy: Member list limited by admin scope.
expectations.accessibility: Confirmation and focus for privileged changes.

stories.title: Respond to external evidence-sharing request
stories.outcome: The client receives a safe scope recommendation without a rushed public link feature.
stories.context: Renee asks for a link that outside counsel can open without an account. Assess recipient identity, expiration, revocation, download scope, legal/process ownership, notification, audit, abuse, and support.
acceptanceCriteria: Response identifies why a hard-to-guess link alone is insufficient
Authenticated guest, one-time exchange, and defer/manual alternatives are compared
Recommendation states schema, authorization, storage, UX, tests, process, estimate, and risk
Current release is not weakened before explicit approval

stories.title: Close cross-client direct object access
stories.outcome: Client B cannot discover or access client A's case or object through any tested path.
stories.context: Marcus supplies synthetic client A/B accounts and a case ID. The visible list is filtered, but a direct detail or download request is exposed.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposure is reproduced and impact bounded with synthetic data
Database/server/storage boundary is corrected rather than only the UI
Regression covers UI, direct URL, server action, database, signed-link issuance, copied link, and revoked member
Incident-style root cause and prevention are documented
stories.seededBug: Load case detail by ID in privileged server code without constraining organization/assignment, then return a signed object URL.

stories.title: Launch and defend the capstone
stories.outcome: Northstar is delivered with evidence, non-claims, operating documentation, and demonstrated comprehension.
stories.context: Run final QA/security triage, production verification, client demo, credential incident drill, rollback discussion, and handoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Production deployment and all critical role journeys are verified
Client guide, admin runbook, deployment guide, incident plan, maintenance proposal, known limitations, and support boundary are complete
Learner explains architecture and traces intake through validation, authorization, storage, audit, notification, and UI
Learner performs a migration-backed field change and diagnoses the seeded access bug
Every graduation category scores at least 3 of 4 and no critical issue remains

expectations.privacy: Synthetic data and non-production claims visible.

nonGoals: Claiming legal admissibility, certification, or production evidence readiness
